value.wording: Shall the resolution enacting approval of a development and supply agreement term summary with EdgeConneX be approved?
value.passage_rule: A majority affirmative vote is necessary for passage

value.subject: Approval of Development and Supply Agreement Term Summary attached as Exhibit A

value.further_approval: Negotiated Development and Supply Agreement must be approved by Village Council
value.source_effect_clause: Emergency council resolution takes effect immediately upon passage only if required affirmative council votes received
